authors: Matthew Dahl, Varun Magesh, Mirac Suzgun, and Daniel E. Ho
title: Large Legal Fictions: Profiling Legal Hallucinations in Large Language Models
summary: Verifiable legal questions, a hallucination taxonomy, and model reliability measurements.
limitation: United States setting; descriptive audit rather than an Indian citation checker.

authors: Varun Magesh, Faiz Surani, Matthew Dahl, Mirac Suzgun, Christopher D. Manning, and Daniel E. Ho
title: Hallucination-Free? Assessing the Reliability of Leading AI Legal Research Tools
summary: Independent audit of reliability claims for leading AI legal research products.
limitation: Product audit and United States setting; no Indian paragraph verifier.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
summary: Combines parametric generation with retrieved non-parametric memory.
limitation: Grounded generation is not quotation verification or legal entailment.

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
summary: ALCE evaluates citation quality in generated answers.
limitation: General question answering and retrieval corpora, not Indian judgments.

authors: James Thorne, Andreas Vlachos, Christos Christodoulopoulos, and Arpit Mittal
title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification
summary: Claim verification against textual sources with support, refute, and insufficient-information labels.
limitation: Wikipedia evidence and general claims rather than legal paragraphs.

title: Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims
summary: SciFact pairs expert-written scientific claims with evidence-containing abstracts.
limitation: Scientific abstracts and expert labels do not transfer directly to judicial propositions.

title: Evaluating the Factual Consistency of Abstractive Text Summarization
summary: FactCC studies factual consistency with synthetic transformations.
limitation: Summary consistency setting; synthetic transformations are not natural legal errors.

authors: Potsawee Manakul, Adian Liusie, and Mark Gales
title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models
summary: Uses disagreement among sampled generations as a reference-free signal.
limitation: No explicit authoritative judgment corpus or paragraph check.

title: LegalBench: A Collaboratively Built Benchmark for Measuring Legal Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Organizes diverse legal reasoning tasks and evaluation procedures.
limitation: Capability benchmark rather than an Indian citation-integrity dataset.

authors: Ilias Chalkidis, Abhik Jana, Dirk Hartung, Michael Bommarito, Ion Androutsopoulos, Daniel Katz, and Nikolaos Aletras
title: LexGLUE: A Benchmark Dataset for Legal Language Understanding in English
summary: Standardizes several legal natural-language-understanding tasks.
limitation: English classification tasks, not Indian quotation integrity.

authors: Vijit Malik, Rishabh Sanjay, Shubham Kumar Nigam, Kripabandhu Ghosh, Shouvik Kumar Guha, Arnab Bhattacharya, and Ashutosh Modi
title: ILDC for CJPE: Indian Legal Documents Corpus for Court Judgment Prediction and Explanation
summary: Indian legal document corpus for judgment prediction and explanation.
limitation: Prediction target differs from checking a cited quotation.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
summary: Introduces bidirectional transformer pretraining for language representations.
limitation: General representation model, not evidence of legal correctness.

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
summary: Efficient sentence embeddings for similarity search.
limitation: Similarity is retrieval evidence only, not entailment.

title: LEGAL-BERT: The Muppets straight out of Law School
summary: Studies domain-adapted pretrained models for legal language.
limitation: English legal-domain pretraining does not provide Indian paragraph labels.

title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
venue: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval
summary: Formalizes probabilistic relevance ranking and BM25 length normalization.
limitation: Retrieval relevance is not legal support.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
summary: Learns dense question and passage encoders for retrieval.
limitation: Open-domain QA differs from within-judgment quotation localization.

title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
summary: Shows retrieval performance varies across heterogeneous zero-shot datasets.
limitation: No Indian judgment collection or paragraph labels.

title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: Introduces the Transformer architecture underlying contextual encoders.
limitation: Architecture paper, not a citation-verification evaluation.

title: TRUE: Re-evaluating Factual Consistency Evaluation
summary: Re-evaluates factual consistency metrics across standardized annotated datasets.
limitation: Summary factuality setting; automatic metrics require task-specific interpretation.

title: Indian Supreme Court Judgments
venue: Registry of Open Data on AWS
summary: Public judgment PDFs and metadata listed under CC-BY-4.0.
limitation: Coverage and extraction limitations are documented in data/manifest.json.
